title: Total oxygen requirement of the activated sludge process

symbols.definition: Ratio of BOD to ultimate BOD

applicability: Total oxygen requirement of the process; the printed text states that the formula does not allow for nitrification but allows only for carbonaceous BOD removal.
notes: Printed units are inside the equation as "(g/d)", and the gas is printed as O₂.
The two definitional formulas printed in the same "where," list (ΔX and Yobs) are recorded separately as Ep372-1.
The 1.42 coefficient is printed with a longer dash-like minus before it: "– 1.42 Δ X". Preserved as printed.
